BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Ordering.Domain

ModuleMeta.Name: Ordering Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Order management DDD domain: Order aggregate with line items and price adjustments, status workflow (pending→approved→completed→cancelled), domain events for state transitions, and adjustment calculator pipeline.
ModuleMeta.StandardsAlignment: Evans DDD · Aggregate Root · Domain Events

Principle.name: Price Snapshot at Order Time
Principle.Description: Line items and adjustments store prices at order creation time — never recalculated from current product prices.
Principle.Rationale: Orders are historical records; changing prices would break financial audit.

Principle.name: Status-Driven Workflow
Principle.Description: Order status transitions (Place→Approve→Ship→Complete) each enforce invariants and raise domain events.
Principle.Rationale: Every state change is validated and auditable.

Principle.name: Adjuster Pipeline
Principle.Description: Price adjustments flow through a composable adjuster pipeline (tax, discount, shipping) for consistent calculation.
Principle.Rationale: Ensures every adjustment follows the same calculation path regardless of source.

Feature.name: Order Aggregate
Feature.Description: Order with line items, adjustments, shipments, billing/shipping addresses, and status workflow.

Feature.name: Line Item Management
Feature.Description: Add, remove, update line items with product variant reference and quantity.

Feature.name: Adjustment Calculation
Feature.Description: Composable price adjustments via adjuster pipeline (discounts, taxes, shipping fees).

Feature.name: Domain Events
Feature.Description: OrderPlaced, OrderApproved, OrderCancelled, OrderCompleted events for downstream integration.

Abstraction.name: Order
Abstraction.Description: Order aggregate root with line items, adjustments, shipments, addresses, status, and domain events.
Abstraction.Purpose: Central entity for the entire order lifecycle from cart to fulfillment.

Abstraction.name: LineItem
Abstraction.Description: Order line item with product variant reference, quantity, and snapshot price.
Abstraction.Purpose: What was purchased — immutable after order placement.

Abstraction.name: Adjustment
Abstraction.Description: Price adjustment (discount, tax, shipping fee) with calculator reference.
Abstraction.Purpose: Modular price modifiers applied through the adjuster pipeline.

Steps.Step: Place: Cart items become order; validate stock; raise OrderPlaced
Approve: Admin confirms order; reserve stock; raise OrderApproved
Complete: All items shipped; raise OrderCompleted
Cancel: Before shipment; release reservations; raise OrderCancelled

AntiPattern.name: Direct Status Setting
AntiPattern.Avoid: Setting order.Status directly — bypasses validation and domain events.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Use order.Place(), order.Approve(), order.Cancel() which enforce invariants.

AntiPattern.name: Recalculating Line Item Prices
AntiPattern.Avoid: Updating line item prices from current product price after order creation.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Prices are snapshotted at order time and immutable.

Scenario.title: Place Order from Cart
Scenario.Context: Customer checks out — cart becomes an order.
